verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack mentions published memory-quality benchmarks such as LongMemEval or LoCoMo, and no documented results back recall-accuracy claims. The only nearby item is a community comment questioning an ad-hoc 'relevancy' score in a launch demo. That is not a published benchmark and does not establish the capability.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can see published memory-quality benchmark results (e.g. LongMemEval, LoCoMo) backing the product's recall-accuracy claims
